description: Dopravní informace is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerstvo vnitra. Up-to-date traffic information. Coverage: Ministerstvo vnitra. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic information" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerstvo vnitra. Its keywords include Dopravní situace. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00007064/98442/distribuce/b72bf3285e37d434ce4a3316d5d6a597/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
